title: NavigationPairedPrediction
description: Opt-in Phase 2 illustrative prediction bound exclusively to the navigationState returned in this same response: same captured source records, basis, evaluation model and departure epoch, with equal sourceRevision. Outer lookup success does not imply prediction success; nested success requires an outer success with supported eligible navigationState. Rejections carry no positions or epochs. Never an ETA, duration, trajectory, clearance, reachability or gravity-assist result.

epochMs.description: Exact integer milliseconds in timeScaleId; authoritative. Display labels are derived from this value, never the reverse.

convergence.description: Diagnostic only; not accuracy, uncertainty or confidence.

residualMs.description: Absolute leg timing residual |g(epochMs) - epochMs| re-evaluated at the returned integer epoch.

coordinateBasisId.description: Same numeric game basis as navigationState; not a physical inertial/barycentric guarantee.

predictionModelId.description: Analytic leg timing has a unique fixed point t = tStart + 1000 * |X(t) - P| / v from fixed start point P to moving Kepler target X. Full-orbit Vbound is the sum of a*(2*pi/period)*sqrt((1+e)/(1-e)) along the verified target chain, including the station link for arrival; fixed rotations preserve norms. No sampling proof. Both Vbound/v ratios must be <=0.5 before iteration; unbounded/unsupported models return EVALUATION_UNSUPPORTED. Leg 1: departure to candidate center. Leg 2: returned encounter to station. Limits: speed [120, 10000] km/s, 64 iterations, 0.1 ms stop, independent integer-epoch residual <=1 ms, 10 Julian-year departure-relative horizon, epochs before 2100. These are pinned to this id. Contraction describes the analytic model, not exact floating-point arithmetic or physical accuracy; numerical failure returns no partial result. Not a physical trajectory or drawn path.

timeScaleId.description: Authoritative calculation scale for every epochMs in this response, including navigationState.epochMs: integer ECMAScript/POSIX milliseconds treated as uniform game time (86,400,000 ms per day; leap seconds not represented). Kepler propagation uses elapsed seconds = delta ms / 1000; element epochs are ISO-8601 Z calendar labels in the same scale. new Date(epochMs).toISOString() is only a readable calendar rendering, not conversion to physical UTC. Calculations are not UTC, TAI, TT or TDB. Preserve exact integer epochMs.

sourceRevision.description: Equals navigationState.provenance.sourceRevision in this same response.

departure.description: Exact copy of navigationState departure.shipId, epochMs and departure.positionKm. The ship is not propagated.

encounter.description: Candidate body center at the illustrative encounter epoch (>= departure.epochMs). Not a flyby point, closest approach, periapsis or clearance-checked position.

arrival.description: Destination station and host center at the same illustrative arrival epoch (>= encounter.epochMs, <= departure.epochMs + 315576000000). positionKm = hostPositionKm + the verified station trajectory.orbit offset evaluated at that epoch, rotated into stellar:sol:catalog-cartesian:v1 by its argument of periapsis, inclination and ascending node. hostPositionKm already includes the full host parent chain; never add a parent twice. The offset is not a frozen departure-epoch offset. Supports the existing bundled orbital trajectory with absent placement metadata or matching active body-orbit/stellar-orbit metadata; no new placement evaluator. hostPositionKm lets Nova distinguish station arrival from host center. Not an ETA.
